sentences.text: 2024 Dated 20.02.2024 Under Section ... vs In Re: Bikram Kabiraj

Author: Soumen Sen
Bench: Soumen Sen
15.07.2024
Court No.29
Item No. 13
 sg
 Crm (A) 2356 of 2024
 In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under Section 438 of the Code
 Criminal Procedure in connection with Tehatta Police Station Case No. 129 
 2024 dated 20.02.2024 under Section 498A/325/307/406/506/34 Ipc.

And
 In Re: Bikram Kabiraj @ Bikram Kobiraj
 Petitioner
 Mr. Atis Kumar Biswas
 Ms. Jyoti Agarwal
 Ms. Piyu Mandal
 For the Petitioner
 Mrs. Baisali Basu
 Ms. Rafat Jahan
 For the State
 1.

Considering the materials available in the case diary, the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and the injury report which directly implicates the petitioner, we are not inclined to grant anticipatory bail to the present petitioner.
2. Accordingly, the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioners is rejected.

(Soumen Sen, J.) (Uday Kumar, J.)
